About the Scholarship

The Cheney scholarships support four-year PhD research in in situ biology at Leeds. The programme focuses on studying biological systems in their context and offers an enhanced stipend, with tuition support specified at the UK home-fee rate.

Research Areas

  • In situ biology
  • Biological systems
  • Biomedical research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryUKRI stipend plus 10%; exact future rate not stated
DurationFour years
TuitionHome-rate funding; international support requires confirmation

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsHome-rate tuition support; confirm any international fee difference.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round26 November 2026
LocationUnited Kingdom

About the University of Leeds

Leeds offers research degrees through its schools, institutes and doctoral training programmes. Its funding routes include subject-specific studentships, university scholarships and awards with particular nationality or widening participation criteria.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://phd.leeds.ac.uk/funding/477-fully-funded-4-year-cheney-scholarship-phd-programme-in-in-situ-biology

Source: phd.leeds.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 26 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 26 November 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
